card.name: Towns and cities in place descriptions
card.fires_on: Words naming a town, city or area, or a word just before one, in geography or history text. Examples are the town, city centres, Port Melbourne, districts and an endemic area.

modes.label: Town or city nouns
modes.description: Words like town, centres or districts that refer to a settlement or its parts.
modes.example: During World War II about 65% of the<< town>> were destroyed.

modes.label: Inside place names
modes.description: Partway through a city or suburb name in a description of that place.
modes.example: A crowd awaits a ship at Station Pier, Port<< Melbourne>>.

modes.label: Modifier before area words
modes.description: An adjective or pronoun in a passage about a place, just before a place noun.
modes.example: Prophylactic drug administration should begin 1 week before arrival in an<< endemic>> area.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed, though the suppressed ones are mostly region and town words.
card.plain: It lights up on words about towns, cities and districts in geography or history passages.
